title: Neon Pulse — Episode 4: The Blueprint Revealed
description: Kael confronts the shocking truth of his origin inside the abandoned facility, only to trigger a massive security lockdown as a shadowy figure watches from the shadows.
character_reference: a tall, lean man with messy dark hair, wearing a worn charcoal-grey tactical jacket with glowing amber circuitry patterns running down his sleeves

scenes.narration: The data files flickered across the cracked terminal, confirming every dark suspicion. My entire life, my powers, my very memories had been engineered in this very room.
scenes.visual: close-up shot of glowing blue holographic data files reflecting across wide tense eyes inside a dark subterranean control room filled with tangled wires and flickering monitors

scenes.narration: Before I could download the master encryption keys, the facility's emergency sirens blared to life. Red strobe lights cut through the dusty air like bleeding blades.
scenes.visual: low angle shot of a man recoiling in shock as harsh crimson emergency lights sweep across rusted metallic walls and heavy overhead pipes in a narrow industrial hallway

scenes.narration: Heavy blast doors slammed shut down every corridor, sealing off my only escape routes. They knew I was here, and they were locking the cage.
scenes.visual: medium wide shot of massive steel bulkhead doors crashing down into the floor, kicking up dust clouds while a lone figure reaches out desperately toward the closing gap

scenes.narration: I channeled the energy coursing through my jacket, letting the amber circuits blaze with intense power. If they wanted a test subject, I would give them a detonation.
scenes.visual: close-up tracking shot of glowing amber patterns flaring up brightly along clothing fabric as intense electric arcs spark and snap wildly between clenched fingertips

scenes.narration: With a deafening blast, I blew the reinforced maintenance hatch wide open, sending molten metal showering into the darkness below. Smoke filled the corridor as I lunged through.
scenes.visual: dynamic action shot of a figure diving forward through a shattered metallic doorway amid an explosion of orange sparks and swirling grey smoke clouds

scenes.narration: Landing hard on the lower gantry, I caught my breath and looked up into the shadows of the upper catwalks. Someone was standing there, watching my every move.
scenes.visual: over-the-shoulder medium shot looking up toward a dark elevated metal walkway where a mysterious silhouetted figure stands motionless in the gloom

scenes.narration: The figure stepped into the dim amber glow, revealing a symbol identical to the one burned into my own memory. This hunt was far from over.
scenes.visual: medium close-up shot of a shrouded figure emerging slightly into flickering amber light, raising a hand to display a glowing geometric emblem on the palm

scenes.narration: The deeper I dig into my past, the more dangerous the conspiracy becomes. Follow along for more chapters of Neon Pulse as the hunt continues.
scenes.visual: cinematic profile portrait shot of a tense man standing before a vast sprawling underground city skyline, staring intently into the distance with glowing amber energy pulsing softly
